option_relations.rationale: AL (primary) amyloidosis matches the leaf label for B2.1, which is AL amyloidosis
Bullous amyloidosis matches the leaf label for B5.2, which is also Bullous amyloidosis
Systemic amyloidosis (AL type) is another term for AL amyloidosis, matching the leaf label for B2.1
Acquired Cutaneous Amyloidosis (Secondary to Multiple Myeloma) could be related to AL amyloidosis, but it's more specific and related to the patient's multiple myeloma condition
